_readme: Example human-in-the-loop (HITL) configuration. Copy the "hitl" block below (or just the parts you need) into the "hitl" section of packages/gateway/config/agentforeach.json. "forms" are named, reusable form definitions (a built-in formType plus an optional JSON Schema and layout hints) that the client renders. "tools" gates MCP tools by exact name or glob before they run: "always" shows the form every time, "when_args_missing" only when a required argument is missing, "confirm_only" asks the user to approve the proposed arguments, and "never" opts a tool out; {argName} placeholders in "intent" are filled from the tool's arguments. "customFormTypes" adds extra request_user_input types that your own client knows how to render (name -> description shown to the model); the built-in types (text_input, confirmation, single_select, multi_select, form) are always available. The example_* tool names are placeholders: replace them with tools your MCP servers actually expose.

customFormTypes.select_contact: contact picker rendered by the app from the user's address book; returns contactId and name. Use it when you need a person you do not already have an id for.
